observations: Photo 0 shows a large industrial sewing machine with multiple spools on a metal rack above, a motor on the right side, and a beige base. The machine has visible wear, including scuffs and dirt on the base and metal parts.
Photo 1 is a side view of the same machine, showing the motor, chain drive, and a label on the front of the base. The machine appears to be mounted on a metal frame with feet.

Photo 2 shows the machine placed on a white worktable with a metal frame. The table has a power switch and a power cord running to the floor. The machine is connected to the table via a black cable. The surrounding area is a plain room with beige walls and a concrete floor.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the machine in any photo.
The machine has multiple thread guides and spools, suggesting it is a multi-needle or heavy-duty sewing machine, possibly for taping or basing in textile or garment production.
The seller claims it is 'neatly used and 100% working'.

claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear and dirt on the machine base and metal parts, but 'neatly used' is subjective. No close-up of interior or moving parts is provided.
No video or photo of the machine in operation is provided. The power cord is connected, but there is no proof of functionality.

risks.risk: machine may not be fully functional or may have internal wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: a video clip showing the machine running with thread feeding and needle moving

risks.risk: hidden damage to motor, gears, or electrical components
risks.proof: close-up photos of the motor, chain drive, and electrical connections, including the power switch and cord

risks.risk: machine may be missing parts or accessories needed for operation
risks.proof: a full inventory photo showing all components, including spools, needles, and any tools or attachments

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, showing thread feeding and needle movement.
Close-up photos of the motor, chain drive, and electrical connections.
Photo showing all included parts and accessories.
response.reason: The machine's identity is known by type, but its functionality and condition cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The claim of '100% working' is unverifiable remotely, and there are hidden risks related to internal wear and missing parts. Proof of operation and close-ups of key components are needed before pricing.
